Scope: Tree-level four-point multisets supported by SM model 1, with its diagonal generation structure and massless neutrinos; all external helicity choices are explicit.
Validation: Notebook representatives have native Feynman, CalcHEP and MadGraph comparisons. Other generations are simultaneous bijective quark/lepton relabelings certified on every elementary vertex and particle mass/spin/color/chirality role. This is not a new independent numerical run for every relabeled process.
